arm-A.title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
arm-A.summary: At the fire-gutted Heart O' The City Hotel, four officers breach Room 303 and the Big Cop forces Trinity to submit at gunpoint, so the squad believes the arrest is finished. Outside, the Lieutenant waves off the arriving Agents and insists his units are bringing her down now, only for Agent Smith to tell him the men are already dead. Back inside, the moment the Big Cop reaches with the cuffs, Trinity moves inhumanly fast: she breaks the cuff attempt, kills the whole squad in a blur of speed and gunfire, and is left standing alone over the bodies.
arm-A.action: Trinity lets the cuff attempt be the trigger, then converts the moment of contact from being the arrested into being the one who decides who lives, leaving her the sole living figure in Room 303. The Big Cop reaches to cuff a compliant suspect and is killed before the reach finishes, his nose shattered and his body thrown across the room into another officer. The squad's disciplined arrest curdles into flailing panic, raking the walls and sweeping lights at something they cannot track, until all of them are disarmed, shot, and dead. Outside, Smith punctures the Lieutenant's certainty with a flat correction and moves in toward a danger he has already measured, while the Lieutenant stays defiant and hostile.

state_triples.reading: Trinity treats the whole raid as a door she opens on her own timing. The 'Shit' at the end is the only leak in that composure — the body catching up after the mind has already finished.

He never gets to learn it, which is the point — the raid was never the victory he believed it to be.

Their panic is the honest picture of men who brought a routine to a fight the rules don't cover, and they pay for the Big Cop's misread with their lives.

affects_outside.enables: The slaughter hands the Agents their opening: with the police unit wiped out, Smith and the others can move in and take over the operation unopposed, and the pursuit of Trinity that they are built for can begin in earnest.

affects_outside.off_screen_reactor: The wider police operation reacts off-screen to the loss of two units and the Agents' takeover; the Lieutenant's defiance outside is the only on-screen echo of a command structure that has just been humbled and displaced.

arm-B.title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
arm-B.summary: The raid on Room 303 begins as a textbook arrest and ends as a slaughter. Trinity submits to the squad's guns, but the instant the Big Cop reaches to cuff her she moves faster than they can follow and kills them one after another until she is the only one left standing, dropping a single 'Shit' as her only crack. Outside, the Agents arrive and strip the Lieutenant of his authority, and Smith informs him that the two units he trusted to be winning are already dead.
arm-B.action: The squad breaches Room 303 and forces Trinity to submit; the Big Cop steps in to cuff her and she turns the arrest into a close-quarters killing, ending with every officer dead. Simultaneously the Agents displace the Lieutenant outside and Smith reveals the units are already gone.

arm-A.title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
arm-A.summary: The raid on Room 303 begins as a textbook arrest and ends as a slaughter. Trinity submits to the squad's guns, but the instant the Big Cop reaches to cuff her she moves faster than they can follow and kills them one after another until she is the only one left standing, dropping a single 'Shit' as her only crack. Outside, the Agents arrive and strip the Lieutenant of his authority, and Smith informs him that the two units he trusted to be winning are already dead.
arm-A.action: The squad breaches Room 303 and forces Trinity to submit; the Big Cop steps in to cuff her and she turns the arrest into a close-quarters killing, ending with every officer dead. Simultaneously the Agents displace the Lieutenant outside and Smith reveals the units are already gone.

arm-A.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-A.summary: Trinity abandons her compromised hardline at the Heart O The City Hotel and runs Morpheus's improvised route to the phone at Wells and Lake. She re-centers on his order, is driven along a worsening path — hall, fire escape, rooftops, window, back stairwell, street — as each exit is closed or guarded in turn: the hall by Agent Brown, the alley below by Agent Smith. She clears a 40-foot gap that Brown then duplicates exactly, dives through a window, and crashes down a stairwell bleeding and broken, moving on adrenaline and discipline until she reaches a phone booth and answers it a split-second before a garbage truck destroys it. She gets out. The Agents are left with no pursuer to catch, but the informant's tip has given them the crew's next target, Neo, and a machine search is already running.
arm-A.action: The event is a single escalating chase that converts a contained victory over the police into a desperate improvisation, and ends by trading Trinity's narrow survival for a colder defeat: the betrayal hands the Agents their next target, Neo. The pivot is physical — the impossible leap — because it is the moment the world's rules are shown breakable by both the hunted and the hunters, and what lets Trinity cross a gap ordinary physics and the cops cannot. The whole run matters because she, not the machine, reaches the phone first, which preserves the crew's lead even as the search turns toward Neo.

What she cannot manage is what she cannot see: her escape is real, but her belief that beating the physical chase is the whole fight is wrong

arm-B.action: After Morpheus confirms the hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake, Trinity bursts into the hall into Agent Brown and his police unit and flees she plummets through the shattered glass and onto the fire escape. Finding Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, she climbs to the roof and runs the rooftops, clearing a 40-foot gap the cops cannot follow while Agent Brown duplicates the leap with the same unnatural grace. She launches from the roof's edge toward a lit window, dives, crashes through glass into a back stairwell, and — finding only wind where she expects Brown — gets to her feet despite her injuries. On the street she races a U-turning garbage truck to a ringing phone booth, answers it, and is gone before the truck pulverizes the booth; the Agents inspect the wreckage with no body, but leave with the next target named as Neo.

arm-A.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-A.summary: Morpheus confirms Trinity's hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake. She runs the building's exterior to the street — hall, fire escape, roof, across the rooftops, and down through a window into a back stairwell — while the Agents pursue and match her. She reaches a ringing booth on the street and is gone before a garbage truck crushes it, so the Agents are left with wreckage and no body, but with the crew's next target named as Neo.
arm-A.action: After Morpheus confirms the hotel hardline is cut and directs her to a phone at Wells and Lake, Trinity bursts into the hall into Agent Brown and his police unit and flees she plummets through the shattered glass and onto the fire escape. Finding Agent Smith waiting in the alley below, she climbs to the roof and runs the rooftops, clearing a 40-foot gap the cops cannot follow while Agent Brown duplicates the leap with the same unnatural grace. She launches from the roof's edge toward a lit window, dives, crashes through glass into a back stairwell, and — finding only wind where she expects Brown — gets to her feet despite her injuries. On the street she races a U-turning garbage truck to a ringing phone booth, answers it, and is gone before the truck pulverizes the booth; the Agents inspect the wreckage with no body, but leave with the next target named as Neo.

arm-B.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
arm-B.summary: Trinity abandons her compromised hardline at the Heart O The City Hotel and runs Morpheus's improvised route to the phone at Wells and Lake. She re-centers on his order, is driven along a worsening path — hall, fire escape, rooftops, window, back stairwell, street — as each exit is closed or guarded in turn: the hall by Agent Brown, the alley below by Agent Smith. She clears a 40-foot gap that Brown then duplicates exactly, dives through a window, and crashes down a stairwell bleeding and broken, moving on adrenaline and discipline until she reaches a phone booth and answers it a split-second before a garbage truck destroys it. She gets out. The Agents are left with no pursuer to catch, but the informant's tip has given them the crew's next target, Neo, and a machine search is already running.
arm-B.action: The event is a single escalating chase that converts a contained victory over the police into a desperate improvisation, and ends by trading Trinity's narrow survival for a colder defeat: the betrayal hands the Agents their next target, Neo. The pivot is physical — the impossible leap — because it is the moment the world's rules are shown breakable by both the hunted and the hunters, and what lets Trinity cross a gap ordinary physics and the cops cannot. The whole run matters because she, not the machine, reaches the phone first, which preserves the crew's lead even as the search turns toward Neo.

His satisfaction, if any, is the impersonal pleasure of a system executing without wasted motion.

state_triples.reading: As a collective, the Agents convert a clear failure into a colder victory: the escaped prisoner matters less than the name the betrayal hands them. Their unity is the point — Jones has the search running before the order, Brown supplies the confirming facts, Smith sanctions the hunt — and the final image of the camera falling through the phone into a relentless 'searching' dramatizes their totalizing surveillance pivoting onto Neo. affects_outside.enables: The Agents now have a named target — Neo — and a machine search already running, which sets the entire next phase of the hunt in motion and drives the story toward Neo's capture attempt.
affects_outside.blocks_or_costs: Trinity's clean escape is real but incomplete as a victory: it costs the crew operational secrecy, since the informant's tip has handed the Agents their next member's name, tightening the net around Neo before anyone on the crew knows it.
affects_outside.off_screen_reactor: The informant (Cypher) — unseen here — is the off-screen engine of the whole reversal: his betrayal is what gives the Agents the name Neo, and his private deal to trade his crew for a return to the Matrix is what neither Trinity nor the Agents yet understands.
